title: 第21章 叫我馨祖第22章 飒风飞羽
content_zh:
韩风以前听说过，有的人家里长辈是大能，为小辈提升修为，能够使用灌顶大法强行提升，虽说有弊端，但也能提升。
可那也是有大能者帮忙才行啊。
自己啥也没有啊，就脑海里有个东西而已。
它不仅能凭空提升修为，还能凭空变出来宝物给他。
这就相当诡异了啊。
这玩意儿到底是什么啊？究竟是哪来的？为什么会在我脑子里？它帮我的目的是什么呢？
韩风依稀记得，这个姻缘赐福好像是可以交流对话的吧？
他干咳了一声，在心里问道，
“赐福大人，您在吗？”
【我在，请说正事。】
脑海里那个声音回答道。
那声音清冷又带着一丝活泼，像人又像是虚无。
“晚辈冒昧问一下，您是谁啊？是人还是仙？”
【是人，也是仙，是神，也是意志，我只是一道存在，我可以是任何形态。】
韩风满头黑线。
这啥意思啊？
“能不能说点我能听懂的呢？”
【你可以理解为，我是来帮你的，因为你不能修炼，不能自主提升修为，所以需要姻缘赐福来帮你提升。】
“那你是怎么进入到我脑海中的呢？”
【因为你捡到了那个玉佩，那是一道规则，一个权限，我并不在你的脑海中，我只是能跟你随时交流沟通罢了，能够随时监察你的状态，你的脑海中有着我的一道意识而已。】

“好吧好吧，看来您肯定也是一位大能者了，那晚辈想问一下，晚辈与您非亲非故，只是一个杂役罢了，您为什么要帮助我呢？”
那个声音，沉默了片刻后，说道，
【你有故人之资，亦有故人血脉。】
“您的故人是谁啊？”
【不可言。】
“好吧，那您这么帮我，肯定不是没有目的的吧，您把我培养起来，需要我做什么回报您呢？”
【不可言。】
“那……晚辈有个不情之请，您这么神通广大，那您知不知道，我的爹娘在哪啊？”
韩风坐直了身体，很认真的问道。
他是个无欲无求的躺平性格，这世上只有两样存在他最在乎。
一是自己的命，二是父母的下落。
原本以为，这个大能者肯定能帮他找到父母，然而，对方却回答道，
【不可言。】
韩风像泄了气的皮球一样，又躺回了椅子上。
啥也问不出来，还是接着躺平吧。
“再问您最后一个问题，您怎么称呼？”
那声音沉默了片刻后，说道，
【叫我馨祖。】
“心……组？”
【温馨的馨，祖宗的祖，记住这个名字，只能你一个人知道，如果将来你在别的地方，看到了我的名字，也不要告诉任何人。】

【好了，修行上有什么不懂的事情，尽管问我就可以了，没什么事的话，不要打扰我，我很忙，需要赐福的时候，我会播报。】
韩风点了点头，不再多言。
只要知道对方是一个能够沟通有些人性的存在就行，怕就怕是什么诡异的东西，将来要夺舍他，那就不好玩了。
content_en:
Han Feng has heard before that in some families, the elders are powerful and can improve the cultivation of the younger ones. They can use the initiation method to forcibly improve them. Although it has disadvantages, it can still improve them.
But that can only be done with the help of powerful people.
I don’t have anything, I just have something in my mind.
Not only can it improve his cultivation level out of thin air, it can also conjure treasures out of thin air for him.
This is quite strange.
What the hell is this thing? Where did it come from? Why is it in my head? What is the purpose of it helping me?
Han Feng vaguely remembered that this blessing of marriage seemed to allow for communication, right?
He coughed dryly and asked in his mind,
"Lord Blessing, are you here?"
[I'm here, please talk about business. 】
The voice in my head replied.
The voice was cold and lively, like a human being but also like nothingness.
"Junior, I would like to ask, who are you? Are you a human or an immortal?"
[I am a human being, an immortal, a god, and a will. I am just an existence. I can be in any form. 】
Han Feng's head is full of black lines.
What does this mean?
"Can you say something I can understand?"
[You can understand that I am here to help you, because you cannot practice and improve your cultivation on your own, so you need the blessing of marriage to help you improve. 】
"Then how did you get into my mind?"
[Because you picked up that jade pendant, it is a rule and an authority. I am not in your mind. I can only communicate with you at any time and monitor your status at any time. You have a consciousness of me in your mind. 】
"Okay, okay, it seems that you must also be a powerful person. Then I would like to ask, I am not related to you, I am just a handyman. Why do you want to help me?"
The voice, after a moment of silence, said,
[You have the resources of an old friend, and you also have the blood of an old friend. 】
"Who is your old friend?"
【Unspeakable. 】
"Okay, then you are definitely helping me so much without purpose, right? You have trained me up, what do you need me to do in return?"
【Unspeakable. 】
"Then... I have a merciless request from this junior. You are so powerful, do you know where my parents are?"
Han Feng sat up straight and asked seriously.
He has a laid-back character with no desires and demands. There are only two things in the world that he cares about most.
One is his own life, and the other is the whereabouts of his parents.
He originally thought that this powerful person would definitely be able to help him find his parents, but the other party replied,
【Unspeakable. 】
Han Feng lay back on the chair again like a deflated rubber ball.
I can't ask anything, so I'd better just keep lying down.
"One last question for you, what do you call me?"
After being silent for a moment, the voice said,
【Call me Xinzu. 】
"Heart...group?"
[Warm Xin, ancestor of my ancestors, remember this name, only you know it. If you see my name somewhere else in the future, don’t tell anyone. 】
[Okay, if you have anything you don’t understand about practice, just ask me. If there’s nothing else, don’t disturb me. I’m very busy. I will report it when you need blessings. 】
Han Feng nodded and said no more.
As long as you know that the other person is a being who can communicate with some humanity, you are afraid that it is some weird thing that will take him away in the future, which will not be fun.
